sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes ReLiMed as ONC-certified EMR with practice management and RCM services. Lists key features: EMR, PM, patient engagement, telemedicine, quality of care. Mentions cloud-based or in-house deployment, 99.9% uptime, customizable templates.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Confirms Version 7.3 certification. Discloses additional costs for patient portal hosting, immunization registry interfaces, FHIR connectivity, and Direct email for care transitions.

EMR feature page. Describes e-prescriptions, electronic lab interface, health guidelines, HIE/immunization registry/ACO interfaces, Direct email, referral tracking, customizable workflows, real-time patient care alerts, integrated practice management.

Practice management feature page. Details scheduling by provider/resource, automated charge entry from clinical documentation, claim scrubbing with real-time alerts, customizable automated posting, in-depth billing reports.

Patient engagement page. Describes patient portal (view health history, lab results, request appointments), secure messaging, self-registration, self-scheduling, kiosk check-in with insurance upload, QR code payment processing.

Telemedicine page. Secure video visits from any device, pre-scheduled and on-demand visits through portal, demographics flow into EMR real-time, provider documentation during visits, post-visit chart note access for patients, online payments.

FQHC/CHC-specific page. UDS reporting built-in, sliding fee schedules with automated poverty-level charges, multi-specialty charting (Women's Health, Pediatrics, Behavioral Health), population health tools, FQHC-specific coding rules, split billing.

RCM services page. Full-service billing with insurance verification, multi-level claim scrubbing, denial management, patient statements, reporting. Describes multi-tier approach combining specialized teams and technology. Built-in messaging tool for billing communication.

Leadership page. Co-founders Renu Kasula (CEO) and Lisa Davies (COO) previously co-founded CareAnyware (home health/hospice solutions). CTO Clint Hopper also from CareAnyware, with experience at Misys and GlaxoSmithKline. All have 20+ years healthcare IT experience.

Software Finder profile. Describes ReLiMed as serving small to midsize ambulatory practices (family, urgent care, pediatrics, internal medicine). Cloud-based, customizable modules for billing, online booking, analytics. Solo provider to multi-specialty group. Custom pricing.

FindEMR profile. Lists features: appointment management, billing, clinical workflow, document management, lab integration, patient portal, e-prescription, reporting/analytics. Supports family medicine, internal medicine, behavioral health, pediatrics, urgent care. Notes lack of automated faxing. Cloud-based, HIPAA/ICD-10/HL7 compliant. Up to 50 physicians.

EHR In Practice profile. Lists integrated EHR, practice management, and patient portal. Customizable reporting, template customization. Personalized support for implementation and training. Small to midsize ambulatory practices.
ZoomInfo company profile (search result only). Confirmed company location in Cary, NC. Used for company background context.
